snippet.title: Arkheron - Next Fest Demo
snippet.description:
Return to the Tower and fight your way to the top floor in the Arkheron Open Demo, live February 20–March 2. No key required. You'll just need to download the game on Steam to play.

Arkheron is a fast-paced dungeon battle royale where player strategy is built in real time. Loot and combine items mid-run, experiment with different Eternal sets and character builds (including two new Eternals revealed earlier this week) and adapt as each match evolves. Push your Echo higher up the Tower while uncovering the fragments of fractured memories along the way.

This open demo is your chance to test playstyles, find groups, and train coordinated teams, while helping polish gameplay systems ahead of Closed Beta as Arkheron moves toward launch.

Wishlist now: 
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3333850/Arkheron/ 
Xbox: https://www.xbox.com/en-US/games/store/arkheron/9PF4B4MD1QZC/0010
PlayStation: https://store.playstation.com/concept/10016490 

Follow us:
Discord: http://discord.gg/arkheron

Reddit: https://www.reddit.com/r/Arkheron/
